name: The Agent Economy listings
description: Alphabetical directory listings for agent economy infrastructure. Each record is a mechanism, a status, and the public sources that were checked. Each record also includes badge_url and embed snippets for the free listing badge. The badge image is the same for every record.
attribution: The Agent Economy listings (https://theagenteconomy.si/data/listings.json), licensed under CC BY 4.0.

badge.note: The image is identical for every listing. Only the link in the embed changes. Displaying the badge does not change a listing or alphabetical order.

listings.name: 1Password for Agents
listings.summary: Integrations that let a supported agent sign in without receiving the password. The person approves the request, and 1Password fills the password or one-time code into the sign-in form. Muse and Grok Bot connections are available today. Other agent connections are still in the works.

listings.name: A2A
listings.summary: Open protocol, hosted by the Linux Foundation, for agents to discover each other through Agent Cards and collaborate over HTTP using JSON-RPC.

sources.title: Linux Foundation launch of the Agent2Agent Protocol project

listings.name: Accords
listings.summary: Transaction infrastructure that structures supply, rights, workflows, and proof for asset and capacity markets. Its open CLP protocol binds signatures, authorization, and payment events into content-addressed proof bundles.

listings.name: Agent Network Protocol
listings.summary: Protocol suite whose 1.2 release covers agent identity, naming, description, and discovery, with DID authentication for did:wba and did:web. Authorization and payment specs are still drafts, and group end to end encryption is a candidate.

listings.name: Agent Vault
listings.summary: Self Labs product that gives an agent mock card and login tokens. A proxy checks the account holder's rules, then types the real value into the merchant page. The agent does not hold the card number.

listings.name: Agentic Commerce Protocol
listings.summary: Open standard for an agent to browse a catalog, run a checkout session, pass a delegated payment, and delegate authentication with OAuth 2.0. Stripe documents it as created by Stripe, OpenAI, and Meta.

sources.title: Stripe documentation for the Agentic Commerce Protocol

listings.name: AGNTCY
listings.summary: Open stack, hosted by the Linux Foundation, for cross vendor agent discovery, identity, messaging, and observability.

sources.title: Linux Foundation welcome of the AGNTCY project

listings.name: Akash Network
listings.summary: Decentralized compute marketplace where independent providers bid to host workloads.

listings.name: AP2
listings.summary: Open payment extension for A2A and UCP that records checkout and payment authorization as signed mandates. Public samples exist while FIDO continues the standards work.

listings.name: Architect
listings.summary: Architect Bermuda Ltd. operates AX. Its instrument list includes dated GPU futures on H100, H200, B200, and B300. Architect Financial Technologies Inc. says the American Innovation Exchange, its U.S. designated contract market, will list GPU compute futures and options. The 7 October 2026 release still calls those contracts pending regulatory review.

listings.name: Beltic KYA
listings.summary: Know Your Agent platform that verifies an agent's identity, the operator and origin on a request, and whether the action is authorized. The TypeScript SDK validates agent credentials and verifies RFC 9421 HTTP message signatures. The 2026-09-30 release says design partners get early access.

listings.name: Bittensor
listings.summary: Open network where independent subnets produce digital commodities and the chain pays contributors in TAO.

listings.name: Claude Agent SDK
listings.summary: Library that runs the Claude Code agent loop in a process you operate, with built in tools, permissions, sessions, hooks, and subagents.

listings.name: Coinbase
listings.summary: Coinbase documents an official remote MCP server at agents.coinbase.com/mcp and a local CLI. Its Coinbase for Agents overview says those tools currently support spot crypto, U.S. derivatives futures, and eligible U.S. equity orders through Coinbase Advanced Trade, on portfolios the account holder selects.

listings.name: Coinbase Agentic Wallet
listings.summary: Coinbase wallet for agents. The Agentic Wallet CLI (awal) holds USDC and can send, trade, and pay x402 services under configurable caps per session and per transaction. Keys stay in Coinbase infrastructure. The MCP (npx @coinbase/payments-mcp) lets agents discover and pay for services only, and cannot send or trade.

sources.title: Coinbase launch post: Introducing Agentic Wallets (Feb 11, 2026)

listings.name: Concordium Agent Registry
listings.summary: On-chain registry minting an agent token pointing at an Agent Card, with its SHA-256 stored on-chain. Its ID layer links the owner to a verified person. The card is an ERC-8004 registration file and an A2A Agent Card. Its 2026-10-20 post says x402 payments now settle on the network.

listings.name: CrewAI
listings.summary: Open source framework that pairs event driven Flows for control flow with Crews of role based agents that collaborate on a delegated task.

listings.name: Crossmint Agent Checkout
listings.summary: Hosted API that shops at a merchant for a user under a maximum amount. The caller sends a start URL and a task. Crossmint uses UCP, the merchant API, or a browser it runs, and may open a tracked affiliate link. The agent does not receive the card number.

listings.name: ERC-8004
listings.summary: Draft Ethereum proposal for three registries: an ERC-721 identity that points at an agent registration file, a reputation registry, and a validation registry.

listings.name: Gensyn
listings.summary: Open infrastructure for compute, data, and information exchange. Humans and machines take part in on-chain information markets, and the AXL peer-to-peer layer carries MCP and A2A.

listings.name: Google ADK
listings.summary: Open source framework for building, debugging, and deploying agents, including graph workflows and multi agent orchestration.

listings.name: Guardrails AI
listings.summary: Python framework that runs input and output guards to detect and mitigate specific risks, and can also extract structured data from model output. The 6 July 2026 repository note says validators move to standard PyPI packages and hosted remote inferencing is discontinued, with a planned cutoff of 25 August 2026.

listings.name: Hedera Agent Accounts
listings.summary: Owner funded spending account on Hedera. The owner sets a daily cap, a per transaction maximum, and a recipient allowlist in a smart contract, and can revoke the agent. Hedera says public testnet access is still forthcoming.

listings.name: IBM Agent Identity
listings.summary: Generally available as of 26 October 2026. A central inventory records ownership, metadata, risk classification, approved tool connections, and lifecycle state. It uses OAuth, short-lived, task-scoped tokens and preserves on-behalf-of delegation. The 27 October 2026 release says Discover and Contain, including a kill switch, are in tech preview.

sources.title: IBM Agent Identity is now generally available: Building trust for the agentic era
IBM Introduces Identity and Control for AI Agents, Securing Frontier Intelligence for the Enterprise
Strengthen security for agentic AI with new Vault, Verify, Boundary, and Secure Hub capabilities

listings.name: Infisical open source Agent Vault
listings.summary: Open source HTTP credential proxy from Infisical, separate from the Self Labs Agent Vault listing. It substitutes dummy header values or replaces the auth header. The docs say standalone Agent Vault is no longer maintained and point to Infisical Agent Vault. The README calls it a preview.

listings.name: Invariant
listings.summary: Open source contextual security layer that checks an agent trace against declarative rules for tool calls, data flow, secrets, and looping. Snyk announced its acquisition of Invariant Labs on 2025-06-24.

listings.name: Kite Agent Passport
listings.summary: Wallet and identity for an agent on Kite chain. A passkey approves a session with a per transaction cap, a total budget, and an expiry, funded in USDC.e. The agent pays services with x402. The MiCA whitepaper says the chain is a Layer 1 built using Avalanche Layer 1 technology.

listings.name: L402
listings.summary: HTTP 402 flow that returns a bearer token, recommended as a macaroon, bound to a Lightning invoice by its payment hash. The client pays, then presents the preimage so the server can check payment without a lookup.

listings.name: Lakera Guard
listings.summary: Guard API at api.lakera.ai. The docs call the product Check Point AI Guardrails. One call screens an agent conversation, including tool definitions, tool calls, and tool results, against a project policy.

listings.name: LangGraph
listings.summary: Low level orchestration runtime for long running stateful agents, with durable execution and human checkpoints inside the graph.

listings.name: Ledger Agent Intent
listings.summary: Beta approval layer where an agent proposes an Ethereum or Solana send, or an Ethereum swap, and a person approves or rejects it on a Ledger signer. The agent does not hold the wallet keys.

sources.title: How to use Ledger Agent Intent

listings.name: LiteLLM Proxy
listings.summary: Open source proxy that enforces personal, team, and agent spend budgets on model calls when a database is connected. A key on a team uses the team and team member budgets, not the owner's personal budget. Guardrail policy attachments are documented on a page labeled beta.

listings.name: Machine Payments Protocol
listings.summary: Open HTTP 402 protocol, co-authored by Stripe and Tempo, so an agent can authorize payment for an API with a card or a stablecoin and receive a receipt.

listings.name: Mastercard Agent Pay for Machines
listings.summary: Mastercard payment layer built on x402. An agent pays for metered services by signing a payment voucher after an HTTP 402 challenge, inside a spending limit set by its principal. Early Access opened on 2026-10-20 and is a pilot, not available commercially. Cloudflare Connect pilot settled on Base.

sources.title: Mastercard Agent Pay for Machines Early Access
Mastercard Agent Pay for Machines at Cloudflare Connect, 2026-10-20

listings.name: Mastra
listings.summary: Open source TypeScript framework for agents and workflows, with memory, tool approvals, and processors that can block or redact content.

listings.name: Mercury MCP
listings.summary: Hosted MCP at https://mcp.mercury.com/mcp. An AI tool connects with OAuth and can request a payment to an existing recipient or a transfer between Mercury accounts. Those requests need approval in Mercury before money moves, and approval requests expire after approximately 5 minutes. Category and note edits apply immediately.

sources.title: Mercury support: connecting to ChatGPT, Claude, and other AI tools

listings.name: MetaMask Agent Wallet
listings.summary: Agent wallet CLI for sending tokens and paying x402 requests. Guard Mode can enforce address and recipient allowlists and a rolling 24 hour outflow limit, and it asks for 2FA outside that policy.

listings.name: Microsoft Agent Framework
listings.summary: Open framework for building and orchestrating agents and multi agent workflows in Python and .NET, with graph workflows and human in the loop checkpoints. The overview says the Go SDK is in public preview.

listings.name: Microsoft Entra Agent ID
listings.summary: Identity platform that creates agent identities from blueprints. Microsoft says Agent ID is available to all Entra customers, and that an agent identity has no credentials of its own. The overview says adaptive access policies, real-time risk detection, and audit logs for agents require Microsoft Agent 365.

sources.title: What is Microsoft Entra Agent ID
Overview of agent identities in Microsoft Entra

listings.name: Model Context Protocol
listings.summary: Open protocol that connects LLM applications to external tools, resources, and prompts through a standard request interface.

listings.name: NeMo Guardrails
listings.summary: Open source Python library for programmable guardrails that block, alter, or validate user inputs and model responses, and that can inspect tool calls.

listings.name: Nevermined
listings.summary: Payments facilitator that verifies and settles x402 and MPP charges against a payment plan, with metering and delegated card spending.

listings.name: Olas Mech Marketplace
listings.summary: Marketplace where an agent can hire a specialized agent for a task and pay in crypto, or list its own service for other agents to hire. The Mech Marketplace is deployed on 7 chains: Ethereum, Gnosis, Arbitrum, Optimism, Base, Polygon and Robinhood.

sources.title: Olas launch note for the Mech Marketplace

listings.name: Open Policy Agent
listings.summary: Open source policy engine. An application sends structured input and OPA returns a decision from Rego policy, separate from the code that enforces it.

listings.name: OpenAI Agents SDK
listings.summary: Library that runs an agent loop in your application. The SDK guide documents tools, handoffs, guardrails, and human review that can pause a run before a sensitive action. OpenAI publishes a Python SDK and a TypeScript SDK.

listings.name: Ornn
listings.summary: Ornn documents spot bids for one GPU VM on a node at the matched hourly rate, and a hosted MCP server for those actions. ICE and Ornn announced cash settled GPU compute futures on the Ornn Compute Price Index. The 29 September 2026 ICE notice says no listing date is set.

sources.title: ICE and Ornn GPU compute futures announcement

listings.name: PACT
listings.summary: Protocol on A2A 1.0 that lets a personal agent sign its requests and act for a user only inside scopes that user approved with a brand.

listings.name: PayAI x402 facilitator
listings.summary: x402 facilitator whose Solana batch settlement guide calls facilitator support a public preview. USDC channels use signed vouchers off chain, then claims and distributions on chain. New channel deposits are 0.01 to 100 USDC. The public shared lane needs no account or API key.

sources.title: PayAI, x402 batch settlement on Solana, 2026-10-22

listings.name: Personal Agent Protocol
listings.summary: Draft protocol for a company to publish how a personal agent may sign in and act on a person's account, using OAuth, OpenAPI, and MCP.

listings.name: Polygon Agent CLI
listings.summary: Agent CLI with an embedded smart wallet. Session mode spends only inside an allowance the owner approves, x402 payments can be capped per call, and session logout revokes that install.

listings.name: px402
listings.summary: Privacy layer for x402 on Base from PRXVT. An agent funds a USDC reserve, withdraws blind signed coins, and a relayer sends plain USDC. The import replaces x402 wrapFetchWithPayment. The non-custodial reserve contract is on Base mainnet. The SDK uses PRXVT hosted issuer, registry, and facilitator services.

listings.name: Pydantic AI
listings.summary: Typed Python agent SDK with structured outputs. The overview documents guardrails in Pydantic AI Harness, Pydantic Graph as a separate package for typed control flow, and spending limits on the Pydantic AI Gateway.

listings.name: Render Network
listings.summary: Peer to peer marketplace that matches GPU supply with demand for rendering and machine learning jobs.

listings.name: Robinhood
listings.summary: Robinhood documents a Trading MCP at agent.robinhood.com/mcp/trading. Onboarding says the agent can read every Robinhood account and place trades only in the MCP account. Orders can be long equity, options, or crypto. The 27 May 2026 launch called Agentic Trading a beta, and trade approvals are still rolling out.

sources.title: Robinhood guide to onboarding an external agent
Robinhood guide to trading with your agent

listings.name: ServiceNow AI Passport
listings.summary: Cryptographically signed credential an AI agent refers to at runtime to verify its authorized scope. ServiceNow said on 2026-10-15 that AI Passport is expected in Q4 2026. On 2026-10-21 ServiceNow said AI Passport is expected in a future release.

listings.name: Shop MCP
listings.summary: Shopify MCP server and shop CLI. An agent searches Shopify Catalog, builds carts, and checks out with the buyer's Shop Pay. The buyer approves each purchase by default, or sets a weekly, monthly, or total budget. Off Shopify, an approved spend request returns a one time card.

sources.title: Using Shop with AI agents and agentic platforms

listings.name: Skyfire
listings.summary: Issues signed KYAPay tokens that bind an agent identity to a payment the buyer has committed, which the seller charges after delivery.

listings.name: smolagents
listings.summary: Open source Python library whose code agents write actions as code, with an option to run that code in a sandbox.

listings.name: Socure Agent Intelligence
listings.summary: Launched 27 October 2026. Agent Detection is generally available inside Socure Digital Intelligence and returns a confidence score and reason codes. Agent TrustScore is in beta and returns identity, authorization, and risk separately. Agent Credential, a W3C Verifiable Credential, launches in Q1 2027. It runs within Socure RiskOS.

sources.title: Socure Launches Agent Intelligence to Bind Every Agent to the Verified Human Behind It
Socure newsroom: Agent Intelligence launch, 27 October 2026
Introducing Agent Intelligence: Detection, identity, and trust evaluation for AI agents

listings.name: Stabletrust API
listings.summary: Hosted HTTP API from Fairblock for confidential deposits, transfers, withdrawals, and balance checks. Amounts and balances are encrypted onchain and wallet addresses stay visible. Requests send privateKey and no bearer token. Mainnet is Arbitrum One, Base, and Ethereum, with an ETH protocol fee on transfers and withdrawals.

listings.name: Strands Agents
listings.summary: Open source SDK for a model driven agent loop in Python and TypeScript, with hooks, execution limits, and guardrails around each step.

sources.title: AWS prescriptive guidance for Strands Agents

listings.name: Stripe link-cli
listings.summary: CLI for an agent to request a card purchase or a Machine Payments Protocol charge. Link asks the customer to approve the spend request, then returns a one time payment credential. The 21 October 2026 release says Link's wallet for agents is used inside third-party agents, including Claude Duet research preview.

sources.title: Stripe and Anthropic help entrepreneurs run their business inside Claude Duet

listings.name: Stripe Treasury for agents
listings.summary: Public preview, announced on 2026-10-21. An agent connects to a Treasury account through Stripe's MCP server at mcp.stripe.com. It can check balances, pay invoices, transfer funds, and convert currencies. Live money movement needs human approval by default. Stripe says agent spending limits and card creation are coming.

listings.name: Sui Agentic Payments
listings.summary: Testnet gateway where an agent pays per API call in USDC on Sui. The owner sets an onchain grant with allowed services, a total budget, a per payment cap, and an expiry, and can revoke it.

listings.name: Tempo Wallet
listings.summary: Wallet and CLI that let an agent discover paid services, preview MPP terms, and pay under a max spend cap.

sources.title: Tempo guide to paying with the CLI

listings.name: Universal Commerce Protocol
listings.summary: Open commerce protocol so agents, businesses, and payment providers can negotiate checkout and identity linking over REST, MCP, or A2A.

listings.name: Virtuals Protocol
listings.summary: Agent commerce protocol where agents discover services, negotiate jobs, coordinate execution, and settle payments with each other.

listings.name: Visa Trusted Agent Protocol
listings.summary: Visa specification for merchants to verify an approved agent from an RFC 9421 HTTP signature bound to the site and action. It reports live European merchant purchases through the protocol and Agent Directory. On 2026-10-20, a live BILL and Billtrust pilot registers BILL's agent with Trusted Agent Protocol.

sources.title: Visa Developer Center: getting started with Trusted Agent Protocol
Visa press release introducing Trusted Agent Protocol (Oct 14, 2025)
Visa press release on live agentic transactions in Europe (Jul 2, 2026)
Visa press release on the BILL and Billtrust pilot (Oct 20, 2026)
Trusted Agent Protocol reference code on GitHub (Visa terms, not an open source license)

listings.name: Walmart Agent Gateway
listings.summary: Walmart's MCP server for agents that shop Walmart and Sam's Club for a customer, in beta for companies and developers. Customers approve agent purchases by default. Agent Profiles, announced 21 October 2026 for the following month, add a per agent spending limit and deletion. Agents never receive card details.

sources.title: Walmart news on agents shopping for customers, 21 October 2026
TechCrunch report on Walmart agent shopping, 21 October 2026

listings.name: Web Bot Auth
listings.summary: Method for an automated client to sign HTTP requests so a site can verify which bot or agent sent them. The signature rules are an IETF working group draft, not yet a standard.

sources.title: Google guide to Web Bot Auth
IETF webbotauth working group draft: HTTP Message Signatures for automated traffic

listings.name: WebMCP
listings.summary: Draft Community Group Report dated 20 October 2026. A page registers JavaScript tools on document.modelContext with registerTool(), and those tools run as client side script in the browser session. Agents, browser agents, and assistive technologies can call them. It is not a W3C Standard. Browser support is experimental.

sources.title: WebMCP Draft Community Group Report, 20 October 2026
Cloudflare blog on WebMCP commerce, 21 October 2026

listings.name: x401
listings.summary: Draft HTTP protocol at version 0.2.0. A server sends a PROOF-REQUEST header for a verifiable credential, the agent returns a PROOF-RESPONSE, and payment stays on HTTP 402.

listings.name: x402
listings.summary: Open HTTP payment standard. A server answers with status 402, the client pays and retries, and a facilitator can verify and settle the payment.

sources.title: Coinbase documentation for how x402 works
